## Domain events

The events of a tenant's event log (`domain: true`); a product module subscribes to these. Machine events are left out.

- app-event-emitted: tenant:tenant-id, seq:u64, revision:state-revision, kind:event-kind, payload:value-map
- file-scan-finished: tenant:tenant-id, seq:u64, revision:state-revision, file:string, verdict:string
- file-scanned: tenant:tenant-id, seq:u64, revision:state-revision, file:hash, clean:bool
- form-submitted: tenant:tenant-id, seq:u64, revision:state-revision, form:form-id, submission:submission-id
- inbox-notice-read: tenant:tenant-id, seq:u64, revision:state-revision, principal:principal-id, notice:string, topic:inbox-topic
- ledger-entry-posted: tenant:tenant-id, seq:u64, revision:state-revision, account:ledger-account-id, unit:ledger-unit, owner:ledger-owner, amount:ledger-amount, balance:ledger-amount, entry-sequence:u64, reason:string
- mail-bounced: tenant:tenant-id, seq:u64, revision:state-revision, message:message-id, recipient:principal-id, category?:message-category-id, reference?:send-reference, permanent:bool
- mail-complained: tenant:tenant-id, seq:u64, revision:state-revision, message:message-id, recipient:principal-id, category?:message-category-id, reference?:send-reference
- mail-delivered: tenant:tenant-id, seq:u64, revision:state-revision, message:message-id, recipient:principal-id, category?:message-category-id, reference?:send-reference
- mail-unsubscribed: tenant:tenant-id, seq:u64, revision:state-revision, message?:message-id, recipient:principal-id, category:string
- member-changed: tenant:tenant-id, seq:u64, revision:state-revision, principal:principal-id, roles:list\<string\>
- record-created: tenant:tenant-id, seq:u64, revision:state-revision, object:object-type-id, record:record-id, version:u64, fields:event-body
- record-deleted: tenant:tenant-id, seq:u64, revision:state-revision, object:object-type-id, record:record-id, before:event-body
- record-updated: tenant:tenant-id, seq:u64, revision:state-revision, object:object-type-id, record:record-id, version:u64, transition?:option\<string\>, before:event-body, after:event-body
- rendition-ready: tenant:tenant-id, seq:u64, revision:state-revision, file:hash, rendition:string, result:hash
- schema-changed: tenant:tenant-id, seq:u64, revision:state-revision, version:schema-version, changes:u64, grandfathered:u64
- session-ended: tenant:tenant-id, session:session-id
- session-started: tenant:tenant-id, session:session-id, principal:principal-id, method:credential-kind, token:session-token, csrf-token:secret
- setting-changed: tenant:tenant-id, seq:u64, revision:state-revision, setting:setting-id, level:setting-level, subject:string
- tenant-created: tenant:tenant-id, seq:u64, revision:state-revision, name:string

## Step and trigger catalogue

The kinds of step an automation may name and the events a trigger may subscribe to (INT-153); a definition naming anything else is refused.

- automation-step create-record{object:object-type-id, fields:map\<field-id, expr\>}
- automation-step update-record{object:object-type-id, record:expr, fields:map\<field-id, expr\>}
- automation-step delete-record{object:object-type-id, record:expr}
- automation-step post-ledger{owner:expr, unit:ledger-unit, amount:expr, reason:string}
- automation-step send-mail{template:template-id, to?:expr, address?:expr, segment?:segment-id, category?:string}
- automation-step create-notice{template:template-id, to?:expr, segment?:segment-id, record?:expr}
- automation-step send-digest{category:message-category-id, template:template-id, since:timestamp, until:timestamp, recipient?:send-recipient, reference?:send-reference, idempotency-key?:string}
- automation-step call-webhook{subscription:identifier, body:map\<string, expr\>}
- automation-step wait-for{duration:duration}
- automation-step wait-until{at:expr}
- automation-step branch{condition:expr, object?:object-type-id, record?:expr, then:step-name, else:step-name}
- automation-step fan-out{segment:segment-id, batch:u32, each:step-name}
- automation-step request-approval{policy:policy-id, timeout:duration, approved:step-name, refused:step-name}
- automation-step end
- automation-step invoke-operation{operation:tenant-operation-id, inputs:map\<string, expr\>}
- trigger-event record-created{object:object-type-id}
- trigger-event record-updated{object:object-type-id, transition?:string}
- trigger-event record-deleted{object:object-type-id}
- trigger-event segment-entered{segment:segment-id}
- trigger-event segment-exited{segment:segment-id}
- trigger-event ledger-posted{unit:ledger-unit}
- trigger-event setting-changed{setting:setting-id}
- trigger-event schedule-due{schedule:schedule-id}
- trigger-event inbound-webhook{endpoint:string}
- trigger-event declared-event{kind:event-kind}

## Capabilities

id [core]: description | roles that hold it

- account-manage [core]: Register a passkey and change a password. | account-holder
- agent-manage [core]: Disable, enable, halt or resume an agent (AGS-413). | owner
- agent-spend-report [core]: Report spend by agent and tenant. | platform-operating-agent,platform-operator
- agents-read [core]: List the agent registry. | owner
- aggregate-read [core]: Read the aggregates that named queries declare, as the audience class of the reader allows (AGG-010). | visitor
- assistant-converse [core]: Post turns to the assistant, read and confirm its pending actions and manage conversations (CNV-200..209). | author,editor,owner
- audit-append [core]: Append an audit entry. | svc-agent-gateway,svc-control-plane,svc-conversation-service,svc-identity-service,svc-operator-console,svc-release-controller,svc-runtime,svc-subject-rights-service
- audit-export [core]: Export the audit log of a tenant. | owner
- audit-read [core]: Query and verify the audit log and read access reports and run traces. | owner
- automations-define [core]: Define and remove triggers and automations, and release or drop their exceptions (WFL-1520). | owner
- automations-read [core]: List automation runs, their steps and their exception records (WFL-1531, SCH-1532). | owner
- breach-notify [core]: Report a breach of personal data to the owner. | platform-operator
- bundle-install [core]: Install a tenant bundle. | owner
- catalogue-read [core]: List and describe the operations of the catalogue and read a long operation (AGT-001..003). | author,editor,owner
- change-approve [core]: Approve a proposal of another principal (AGS-409). | editor,owner
- change-project [core]: Project a proposed change and replay the journal. | author,editor,owner
- change-propose [core]: Propose a change for approval. | author,editor,owner
- change-undo [core]: Undo an applied agent change. | author,editor,owner
- consent-record [core]: Record a consent decision of a visitor. | visitor
- content-delete [core]: Delete an article. | editor,owner
- content-draft-read [core]: Read the authoring views, previews, diffs and versions of unpublished content. | author,editor,owner
- content-read [core]: Read published views, queries, feeds, sitemaps, search and the public pages. | author,editor,member,owner,visitor
- content-restore [core]: Restore an earlier version of a record. | editor,owner
- content-write [core]: Save drafts and record edits, create and change articles, upload files and announce presence. | author,editor,owner
- diagnostics-run [core]: Run a read-only diagnostic operation for one tenant. | owner,platform-operating-agent,platform-operator
- directory-provision [core]: Provision, update and deactivate people and map groups to roles by SCIM. | directory-provisioner
- domain-manage [core]: Bind a domain name to a tenant and remove the binding. | owner
- edge-control [core]: Purge edge copies and register tenant domains at the edge. | svc-control-plane,svc-runtime
- events-declare [core]: Declare and emit the event kinds of the tenant (SCH-1576). | owner
- events-subscribe [core]: Subscribe to the domain events the principal may read. | author,editor,owner
- flags-manage [core]: Read or change a tenant switch of a feature flag as tenant metadata (AGT-420, D-6202). A platform flag or a quota needs platform-flags-manage. | owner
- fleet-report [core]: Report across tenants. | platform-operator
- form-submit [core]: Obtain a submission token and submit a form. | visitor
- grant-manage [core]: Create and revoke grants and rotate client secrets. | account-holder
- health-read [core]: Report the health of a component. | visitor
- identity-federate [core]: Complete an OpenID Connect sign-in or deliver a SAML assertion, signed by the identity provider. | identity-provider
- identity-sign-in [core]: Sign in, sign up, recover an account and read the public sign-in pages and keys. | visitor
- invitation-redeem [core]: Accept an invitation with the address it names (ADM-153). | account-holder,visitor
- jobs-manage [core]: Schedule, cancel and retry jobs and define schedules. | owner
- jobs-read [core]: List jobs and schedules. | editor,owner
- jobs-run [core]: Lease due jobs, report results and run workflows. | owner,svc-automation-worker
- layout-apply [core]: Apply a storage layout change to one tenant database. | platform-operator
- ledger-configure [core]: Declare units and pools of the tenant ledger and set their limits. | owner
- ledger-post [core]: Post an entry to an account of the tenant ledger. | owner
- ledger-read [core]: Read the balance and the entries of an account of the tenant ledger that the policies of the reader permit. | author,editor,owner
- ledger-read-own [core]: Read the balance and the entries of the ledger accounts that the caller owns, and of no other account (LDG-1541). | account-holder,owner
- listener-rule-set [core]: Set the listener rule of a component. | svc-release-controller
- mail-configure [core]: Define mail templates, prove sender domains and manage the suppression list. | owner
- mail-read [core]: List the mail log. | editor,owner
- mail-report [core]: Deliver a signed delivery report. | mail-provider
- media-deliver [core]: Receive an uploaded file at a signed address. | visitor
- media-sign [core]: Sign an address for a private media file. | author,editor,owner
- members-manage [core]: Assign and revoke the roles of people, add people to teams and remove them, and invite people to hold roles. Conferring a role also needs every permission and capability the role grants (ADM-152). | moderator,owner
- messages-send [core]: Send a templated message or inbox notice to a principal, an address or a segment (EML-1560). | owner
- migration-batch [core]: Run one batch of a migration run. | svc-migration-job
- migration-run [core]: Preview, start and stop a migration run. | owner
- model-generate [core]: Generate a reply with the model provider and report its usage. | svc-conversation-service
- notifications-manage [core]: Mark one's own notices read, unread or removed, and set one's own notification preferences (NTF-1569, NTF-1571). | account-holder,owner
- notifications-read [core]: Subscribe to notifications and list one's inbox. | account-holder
- operation-invoke [core]: Invoke an operation of the catalogue (CNV-202). | author,editor,owner
- outbound-call [core]: Call an external address and fetch identity provider metadata through the outbound gate. | svc-connector-runner,svc-identity-service
- placement-dedicated: Be placed in a cell that serves no other tenant (D-503): a placement whose cell holds one tenant. | platform-operator
- plan-change [core]: Change the plan of a tenant. | owner
- plan-contract-record [core]: Record the contract that lets a tenant hold the Enterprise plan (D-6202). | platform-operator
- platform-describe [core]: Describe the platform topology and health. | platform-operating-agent,platform-operator
- platform-flags-manage [core]: Change a feature flag or a quota of any tenant. No tenant role holds it (D-6202). | platform-operator
- realm-configure [core]: Change the sign-in configuration of a tenant's realm. | owner
- records-import [core]: Import records from an archive. | owner
- records-read [core]: List tenant records in pages. | author,editor,owner
- release-build [core]: Build component images and create release records. | svc-release-controller,svc-release-pipeline
- release-deploy [core]: Apply a deployment descriptor. | platform-operating-agent,release-engineer
- release-drift-report [core]: Report drift of an environment. | platform-operating-agent,release-engineer
- release-freeze [core]: Declare a change freeze. | platform-owner
- release-promote [core]: Promote a release. | release-approver
- release-switch [core]: Switch the live colour of a component and switch back. | release-engineer
- releases-read [core]: List production releases. | platform-operating-agent,platform-operator,platform-owner,release-approver,release-engineer
- requirements-read [core]: Read the verification status of requirements. | platform-operating-agent,platform-operator
- sandbox-keep [core]: Keep a sandbox tenant past its period. | owner
- sandbox-start [core]: Start a sandbox tenant. | account-holder
- segments-define [core]: Define, change, remove and test segments. | owner
- segments-read [core]: List the members of a segment. | editor,owner
- segments-read-own [core]: List the segments marked visible to members that the caller belongs to (SEG-1540). | account-holder,owner
- self-data-export [core]: Ask for and fetch an export of the data that concerns the principal, and only that (D-8261). The data of another person needs subject-rights. | author,editor,member,owner
- self-events-read [core]: Subscribe to the events of records the principal may read, and to no others (D-6591). | member,owner
- self-file-upload [core]: Upload a file into a file field that a policy lets the principal write, within that field's size cap (D-6591). Grants no other upload and no publication. | member,owner
- self-record-write [core]: Create and change records that the policies permit the principal to write and that the principal created or that name the principal as their data subject (D-6591). Grants no draft, article or publication operation. | member,owner
- session-end [core]: End every session of a principal. Looking a session up is session-verify (D-6203). | svc-runtime
- session-manage [core]: Sign out, list and revoke one's own sessions. | account-holder
- session-verify [core]: Look up a session and introspect a token. Ending the sessions of a principal is session-end. | svc-agent-gateway,svc-conversation-service,svc-gateway,svc-operator-console
- setting-define [core]: Define, change and lock the settings of the tenant (SET-001). | owner
- setting-read [core]: Read the resolved value of the settings for oneself (SET-010). | account-holder
- setting-resolve-for [core]: Resolve the setting of a recipient inside the platform, for the mail dispatcher and the notification service (SET-1541). | platform-service
- setting-write-person [core]: Set and remove the person level of a setting for oneself (SET-033, SET-034). | account-holder
- setting-write-platform [core]: Set and remove the platform level of a setting (SET-030). | platform-operator
- setting-write-team [core]: Set and remove the team level of a setting (SET-032). | owner
- setting-write-tenant [core]: Set and remove the tenant level of a setting (SET-031). | owner
- site-configure [core]: Read and save the publication settings. | editor,owner
- subject-rights [core]: Export, rectify, restrict and erase the data of one principal, export the processing record and place legal holds. | owner
- submissions-export [core]: Export the submissions of a form. | owner,submissions-reader
- subscription-link [core]: Follow a signed link to unsubscribe or resubscribe without a sign-in (EML-1562). | owner,visitor
- support-grant-issue [core]: Issue and withdraw a support grant (ADM-163, ADM-165). | owner
- takedown-issue [core]: Take a tenant or one host down for abuse, a legal order or a security incident, and release that takedown. Held by the platform operator only (THR-1226). | platform-operator
- telemetry-export [core]: Export telemetry and raise alerts. | svc-telemetry-pipeline
- telemetry-read [core]: Query metrics, logs and traces. | owner
- template-upgrade-offer [core]: Offer a newer template version to a tenant. | platform-operator
- tenant-configure [core]: Change the tenant settings: audit retention, the outbound allow-list, file limits, default and fallback language, and the other values of tenant-settings (D-6594). | owner
- tenant-delete [core]: Request the deletion of a tenant and cancel it within the grace period. | owner
- tenant-export [core]: Export the whole of a tenant. | owner
- tenant-fork [core]: Fork a tenant for a projection. | owner
- tenant-move [core]: Move a tenant to another placement and switch it there. | platform-operator,svc-migration-job
- tenant-operation-invoke [core]: Invoke a tenant operation whose invokers name the caller (OPR-1546). | account-holder,owner
- tenant-provision [core]: Create a tenant with its database, layout and template. | platform-operator
- tenant-resolve [core]: Read the tenant directory: entries, host names and due work. | svc-automation-worker,svc-gateway,svc-runtime
- tenant-restore [core]: Restore a tenant to a point in time. | owner
- tenant-support-read [core]: Open the operator console for one tenant, under a live support grant of that tenant (G-165, ADM-163..165, D-6204). | owner
- tenant-suspend [core]: Suspend a tenant and resume it. | platform-operator
- token-exchange [core]: Exchange a token for a delegated token (TOK-004). | account-holder
- token-issue [core]: Obtain an access token by client credentials. | api-client
- tokens-define [core]: Define and remove content tokens. | owner
- upload-scan [core]: Scan an uploaded file. | svc-runtime
- webhook-receive [core]: Deliver a signed inbound webhook. | webhook-sender
- webhooks-manage [core]: Create inbound webhook endpoints and rotate their secrets (INT-1578). | owner
- webhooks-read [core]: List outbound webhook deliveries. | owner
- workflow-activate [core]: Activate a workflow definition. | owner
- workflow-approve [core]: Approve a waiting workflow step. | editor,owner

## Plans

- business: D-508: 50 connections, 200 requests a second, 100 GB, 100,000 jobs a day, 50,000 emails a month. The core capabilities only.
- enterprise: D-508: quotas set by contract, and a dedicated database instance available (D-503). | adds placement-dedicated
- standard: D-508: 20 database connections, 50 requests a second, 10 GB stored, 10,000 jobs a day, 5,000 emails a month. The core capabilities only.
